purpose: Offline, reviewable SEO metadata corrections for existing CMS tool records. Nothing here has been written to any CMS.
currentValuesSource: read-only SELECT on the production CMS database (public metadata, also present in page HTML)
proposedValuesSource: reviewed source copy on frontend PR #56 (src/data/*-content.ts); enforced equal by scripts/seo/__tests__/cms-seo-corrections.test.mjs
applyRules: Owner authorization required before any CMS change.
Apply only as draft versions of the existing records (same CMS ID), first on verified isolated staging.
Change only seo.metaTitle and seo.metaDescription; leave og/twitter fields empty so they inherit.
Never publish, create duplicates, or trigger indexing as part of this change.

corrections.reason: CMS calls it a "heart risk estimate"; the tool is an illustrative checklist, not a validated risk score.

current.metaDescription: An educational lifestyle-based heart risk estimate — not a diagnosis.

proposed.metaDescription: Review five heart-health factors using illustrative points, not a validated heart disease risk score. Ask your clinician about AHA PREVENT.

corrections.reason: CMS promises a "risk band"; the tool is an illustrative checklist, not a validated screening score.

current.metaDescription: A non-diagnostic diabetes risk band — and why to get screened.

proposed.metaDescription: Explore factors linked to type 2 diabetes with illustrative points, not a validated screening risk score. Learn about laboratory testing.

corrections.reason: CMS promises a combined "risk-level"; the tool no longer produces an unvalidated combined risk score.

current.metaDescription: Combine your BMI and waist-to-height ratio into a risk-level explainer.

proposed.metaDescription: Calculate BMI and waist-to-height ratio side by side. Learn what each measure means and its limits, without an unvalidated combined risk score.

corrections.reason: CMS title and description promise "reversal" and a "personalized" recipe; no step count can guarantee reversal.

current.metaDescription: Offset desk time with micro-breaks and extra NEAT steps — get a personalized movement recipe.

proposed.metaTitle: Sitting & Movement Break Planner — Optional Steps and NEAT
proposed.metaDescription: Explore optional breaks and step ideas for a sitting day. No step count guarantees reversal of sitting-related health effects; calories are approximate.

corrections.reason: CMS says the estimate uses your max heart rate; max heart rate is predicted from age, and the result is not a fitness grade.

current.metaDescription: Estimate your cardio fitness from your resting and max heart rate.

proposed.metaDescription: Get a rough VO₂ max estimate from your age and resting heart rate using the Uth–Sørensen heart-rate ratio. An illustration, not a lab test or fitness grade.

corrections.reason: CMS frames food as something to "burn" off; the tool uses energy above rest and avoids earn/burn framing.

current.metaDescription: Enter a food or calories to see the minutes of walking, running, or cycling to burn it.

proposed.metaTitle: Walk It Off Calculator — Food to Exercise Time
proposed.metaDescription: Explore illustrative walking, running, and cycling time using estimated extra activity energy above rest. Food is not something you must earn or burn off.

corrections.reason: CMS presents "metabolic age" as estimable; the tool is an illustrative BMR index, not a measure of metabolic health.

current.metaDescription: Estimate your metabolic age from your BMR vs the average for your age (illustrative).

proposed.metaDescription: See a fictional BMR-based age index with transparent assumptions. It does not measure metabolic health or biological age.

corrections.reason: CMS ranks "highest-impact next steps" (unsupported) and its description is cut off after "Educational".

current.metaDescription: Score your everyday habits (0–100) against WHO and CDC lifestyle guidance and see your 2–3 highest-impact next steps. Educational

proposed.metaDescription: Score everyday habits (0–100) against WHO and CDC guidance and see which habits have the most model points left. Educational, not a lifespan prediction.

corrections.reason: CMS calls it a heuristic "from sports-science principles"; the tool states it is site-defined and not validated.

current.metaTitle: Recovery Time Calculator — Rest Between Workouts
current.metaDescription: Estimate how long to rest before training the same muscle group again. A transparent heuristic from sports-science recovery principles. Free, no signup.

proposed.metaTitle: Recovery Time Calculator — Rest Between Workouts
proposed.metaDescription: Explore a site-defined recovery planning estimate for hard workouts. Understand limits, effort, sleep and soreness; not a validated healing timer.

corrections.reason: CMS states a measurement ("find how much … is muscle"); the tool gives a Boer (1984) estimate.

current.metaDescription: Find how much of your weight is muscle, bone, and organs — not fat.

proposed.metaDescription: Estimate fat-free body mass using Boer (1984), with safeguards when a regression gives a physically impossible result. Educational, not clinical.

corrections.reason: CMS says "how much water to drink"; the tool estimates total fluid (drinks + food) and is not a target.

current.metaDescription: Find how much water to drink each day, in liters and fluid ounces.

proposed.metaDescription: Estimate your total daily fluid from body weight and activity, and the part from drinks, in liters and fluid ounces. A rule of thumb, not a target or limit.

corrections.reason: CMS says "calories burned"; the tool separates gross and above-rest energy.

current.metaDescription: Turn your step count into distance walked and calories burned.

proposed.metaDescription: Convert steps to approximate walking distance, gross energy and above-rest energy from height and weight. Kilometers or miles; no measured calorie claims.

corrections.reason: Accurate as published; the source adds the gross/above-rest distinction.

current.metaDescription: Estimate calories burned by activity using MET values and your weight.

proposed.metaTitle: Calories Burned Calculator — Gross vs Above-Rest METs
proposed.metaDescription: Estimate gross activity energy and illustrative above-rest calories for exercise using MET values, weight and duration. Includes metric/imperial inputs.

corrections.reason: Accurate as published; the source adds that no threshold is risk-free.

current.metaDescription: Add up the hidden calories in your weekly drinks — per week, month, and year.

proposed.metaDescription: Estimate weekly, monthly and yearly beverage calories from alcohol. No predicted fat gain or risk-free drinking threshold.
